_about: Steel Accord - U.S. concept-pack sprites (AI-generated, client-supplied, DEV ONLY). Generated by tools/import_us_packs.py; do not edit by hand.

ah64.notes: 4-blade main rotor split. Blade roots that lie over the fuselage, stub wings and hub are kept in the body as drawn (no repainting); tail rotor left in the body.

uh60.notes: 4-blade main rotor split. Blade roots over the cabin roof stay in the body as drawn (no repainting); tail rotor left in the body.

ch47.notes: Tandem rotors: blades contains both rotors; blades_front/blades_rear (extra files, same canvas) hold each rotor alone so they can spin about their own hub (counter-rotating). The source draws only TWO blades per rotor clear of the fuselage (~100 deg apart, not 3 at 120 deg). The rear rotor's third blade is painted along the fuselage spine and the front rotor's third blade is not drawn at all; the spine blade cannot be removed without repainting the fuselage, so it stays baked into the body and will be visible as a static blade under the spinning rotor. Use split only with that caveat, or fall back to the unsplit top sprite.
